spans.s: गो—जर m. an old ox or bull, BhP. iii, 30, 14.
गो—जल n. cow's urine, L.
गो—ऽजवाज v.l. for गज-व्˚, q.v.
गो—जा॑ mfn. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 67, Kāś.) produced by milk (‘born amidst rays’, Sāy.; ‘born in the earth’, Mahīdh.), RV. iv, 40, 5 (KaṭhUp. v, 2).
गो—जागरिक m. a kind of prickly nightshade, L.
गो—जागरिक n. happiness, fortune, L.
= भक्ष्य-कारक (preparer of food, baker?), L.
गो॑—जात (गो॑-), mfn. born in the starry sky (said of the gods; ‘born in the middle region’, Sāy.), RV. vi, 50, 11; vii, 35, 14 and x, 53, 5.
गो—जा-पर्णी f. the shrub Dugdha-phenī, L.
गो—जि॑त् mfn. conquering or gaining cattle, RV.; AV.
गो—जिह्वा f. N. of a plant (Phlomis or Premna esculenta, L.; Elephantopus scaber, L.; Coix barbata or a kind of Hieracium, L.), Car. i, 27, 86; Suśr. i, 46, 4, 51.
गो—जिह्विका f. the uvula, Car. iv, 7
= ˚ह्वा, Suśr.; Mn. vi, 14, Sch.
गो॑—जीर (गो॑-), mf(आ)n. stimulated by milk added (Soma), RV. ix, 110, 3.
गो—जीव mfn. living on (trade with) cattle, Hcat. i, 7.
for ˚जी, q.v.
N. of a plant with sharp leaves, Suśr. i, 8, 11; iv, 9 and 18 f.; v, 7, 1; vi, 24, 26.
गोजि—काय m. for गाञ्जिक्˚, Gal.
for गौञ्ज्˚, q.v., Gal.
